AppUsers.Description: The people approved to sign in. There is no sign-up: a verified email address only gets someone in if it is a row here and IsActive. Roles come from this table, never from a token. Added by the effortless-magic-links seed.

schema.name: AppUserId
schema.Description: Stable id of the approved user. The seed uses the lower-case email address.

schema.name: EmailAddress
schema.Description: The address the person signs in with. Matched case-insensitively against the verified email in the magic-link token.

schema.name: DisplayName
schema.Description: How the app shows this person.

schema.name: Role
schema.Description: What the person may do: admin, or a role your policies name. Comma-separate to give several.

schema.name: IsActive
schema.Description: False keeps the row but lets the person in no more.
